title: DIY Trucker Hat Experience in Charleston
includes: Selection of Hat, Tote, etc (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Price signages are all displayed and easily located to know the differences
For guests celebrating special occasion can bring food and utensils. Please inform us prior to your scheduled date.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are an interactive trucker hat making experience with a nostalgic camp themed cafeteria twist. You won't find mashed potatoes on our menu. Book a private in-store experience for just you and all your friends! You will enjoy the entire storefront to yourself, a personal hat barista to guide you through your hat making experience, access to play your own music, and champagne for each guest!
